# Training Magazine

> > Training Magazine is a 50+ year resource for training professionals covering workforce development, leadership training, AI skills, and industry best practices.

Training Magazine, published by Lakewood Media Group, serves as a comprehensive platform for learning and development professionals. The site offers award programs, conferences, subscriptions, and expert articles on emerging training trends including AI upskilling, employee experience, and talent retention.

## Key Topics

- Learning and Development
- Leadership Development
- Employee Training
- Training MVP Awards
- Emerging Training Leaders
- AI Skills Development
- Corporate Learning
- Training Professionals
- Professional Development
- LMS Migration
- Upskilling Culture
- Training Accountability
- Employee Experience
- Industry Recognition
- Training Magazine Network

## Workforce Development & Skills Training

- [AI is Here: The Top 5 Skills Employers Need to Develop Right Now](https://trainingmag.com/ai-is-here-the-top-5-skills-employers-need-to-develop-right-now): Article on top 5 AI skills employers need for workforce development
- [Creating a Culture of Upskilling: A Strategic Imperative for Modern Tech Teams](https://trainingmag.com/creating-a-culture-of-upskilling-a-strategic-imperative-for-modern-tech-teams): Article on upskilling culture for talent retention and workforce development
- [4 Hourly Employee Payroll Trends to Watch](https://trainingmag.com/4-hourly-employee-payroll-trends-to-watch): Article on payroll trends and workforce management for hourly employees

## Leadership & Organizational Development

- [Training Accountability: How to Build it in from Day One](https://trainingmag.com/training-accountability-how-to-build-it-in-from-day-one): Article on building training accountability in leadership workshops
- [How Consistent Is Your Employee Experience?](https://trainingmag.com/how-consistent-is-your-employee-experience): Article on consistency in employee experience and manager training
- [Women Rising: Break the Glass Ceiling](https://trainingmag.com/women-rising-break-the-glass-ceiling): Article on women leadership, glass ceiling barriers, and career advancement
